items.title: Implement AFPL operating framework
items.exact_claim: The lab has persistent validated state, role separation, executable prompt assembly, and tested operating procedures.
items.success_criterion: All required documents exist; labctl validate and unit tests pass; repository document map points to AFPL.
items.kill_condition: Validation or role machinery cannot operate without heavyweight dependencies or destructive state mutation.
items.next_action: Codex or Research Director confirms the claude red-team repairs (2026-07-12), then REPLICATING via clean-checkout validate+tests.
items.resource_ceiling: Docs, scripts, tests, and state only; no Lean builds; no external spend.

items.title: Changing-cell arbitrary-L2 projection capstone
items.exact_claim: The explicit scheduled cell-average projections converge strongly to the identity on the declared L2 space.
items.success_criterion: Kernel-checked final epsilon theorem with active-cell and ultraviolet controls, followed by semantic audit.
items.kill_condition: The proposed pointwise/cell projection is not representative-safe or the active boxes fail to exhaust the norm.
items.next_action: Inspect the latest snapshot of Aristotle project b7405f03 before local or duplicate proof work.
items.resource_ceiling: Harvest b7405f03 first; at most one further focused Aristotle package; targeted lake builds only.

items.title: Finite support under a noncompact rational boost
items.exact_claim: An explicit noncompact rational 1+1 Lorentz boost preserves the Minkowski form but no finite invariant support can contain the selected nonzero future vector.
items.success_criterion: Kernel theorem, infinite-orbit witness, zero-vector and identity controls, and source-audited interpretation.
items.kill_condition: The chosen exact scalar field or orbit statement does not support the claimed finite-set no-go.
items.next_action: Prepare a focused Lean theorem statement and context pack.
items.resource_ceiling: One focused Mathlib-only Aristotle package; no full-repo package.

items.title: Pair-generator maximum-entropy modular selection
items.exact_claim: For displayed finite constraints, the unique Gibbs state has modular flow equal to the Pluecker pair evolution up to explicit beta rescaling.
items.success_criterion: Unique-state theorem, flow equality, covariance, noncommuting phase-sensitive witness, and input ledger.
items.kill_condition: The uniqueness assumptions encode the desired state or the flow result is only a definitional restatement with no operational witness.
items.next_action: Opus prepares the theorem/source packet; Codex audits existing ModularSelection semantics.
items.resource_ceiling: Context-pack preparation plus at most one Aristotle package; no full-repo package.

items.title: Overlap gauge covariance and index invariance
items.exact_claim: Unitary gauge conjugation of a gapped Hermitian kernel transports its certified sign and overlap operator and preserves the trace index.
items.success_criterion: General theorem plus nonidentity gauge witness, trivial-index control, and gap-closing boundary.
items.kill_condition: The existing certified-sign API lacks conjugation naturality or the proposed gauge hypotheses are insufficient.
items.next_action: Inspect GateC2 definitions, PhysLean conventions, and matrix functional-calculus APIs.
items.resource_ceiling: Targeted lake builds; one focused Aristotle package only if locally stalled.

items.title: Rest-operator/pair-generator active-sector bridge
items.exact_claim: A canonical active-sector map intertwines the two-by-two Pluecker rest operator and pair generator, while a stated rank or representation obstruction blocks a naive full-sector equivalence.
items.success_criterion: Explicit map, operator/evolution corollaries, nonzero and zero controls, and no-extension theorem.
items.kill_condition: The map is only a chosen coordinate identification or the full-sector distinction has no invariant content.
items.next_action: Compare exact definitions and state the strongest non-hollow bridge.
items.resource_ceiling: Design and audit only until the intertwiner statement typechecks; no proof-search spend before that.

items.title: Establish the literature and knowledge-graph baseline
items.exact_claim: Every load-bearing claim in the active manuscript portfolio has a canonical primary-source record, a recorded convention check, and a discoverable Zotero/Neo4j path or an explicit source-debt entry.
items.success_criterion: Audit the active manuscripts, deduplicate canonical identifiers, refresh document and paper indexes, and pass known-answer retrieval checks recorded in an archive maintenance report.
items.kill_condition: The available source text or identifiers are insufficient to establish canonical provenance for a load-bearing claim; that claim must be downgraded or entered as source debt.
items.next_action: Inventory active manuscript citations and establish known-answer retrieval queries before changing Zotero or Neo4j.
items.resource_ceiling: Read-only Zotero/Neo4j until known-answer checks pass; writes follow the dedup protocol.

items.title: Build the first evidence-preserving public explanation ladder
items.exact_claim: The program overview can be translated into general-reader, undergraduate, and adjacent-researcher forms while preserving the same evidence grades, formal anchors, and kill conditions.
items.success_criterion: Produce three audience briefs with a shared claim map, at least one tested visual explanation, and research-owner plus Skeptic review.
items.kill_condition: A central public-facing claim cannot be expressed accessibly without becoming materially stronger or less falsifiable than its technical source.
items.next_action: Take Sources/Null_Edge_Program_Overview_Packet_2026-07-12.tex as the baseline artifact; extract its ten most important claims and map each to a state/CLAIMS.json row or literature anchor.
items.resource_ceiling: Docs only; every public-facing claim must map to a claim-registry row.
